entries.task: Author the solution plan for csv-parser-dotnet, a .NET 10 port of the csv-parser-java learning exercise. First record the person's brief in docs/planning/brief.md: the Java project's brief (a console app that reads CSV files from a folder, deserializes them into Person objects, persists them and displays every stored record), restated for .NET 10, SQL Server through Entity Framework Core instead of H2, LocalDB as the reachable server, and a sample that never goes into production. Then write docs/planning/solution-plan.md: the objective; a Production split stating there is none (one console process, the only part that talks to the database); the Handoff artifacts (the console app as `dotnet publish` output, the database as an idempotent EF Core migration script); the four modules as four .csproj projects in the root solution file reaching each other by <ProjectReference> (PersonModel, CsvDeserializer, CsvDatabase, CsvParserApp), each with responsibility, contract, dependency direction, the reason for the cut and the cuts deferred; the resolved decisions carried over from the Java plan (Person fields and CSV headers, database location, console output format); and the phases from the skeleton (session 3) to the console app (session 7).
